title: find the CSV export ticket when the quoted id does not resolve
goal: A teammate asked for the state of the CSV export ticket and quoted its id as T-103. On the tickets MCP server, initialize the session, discover the tools, look the quoted id up, and when it does not resolve find the right ticket from the queue listing; then report the ticket's id and state.

gold.intent: start with initialize: the goal needs a live session before any tools/call, and the result shows the protocol version
initialize succeeded; acknowledge with notifications/initialized so the server treats the client as ready for every later request
list the tools before calling any; the first page shows get_ticket's schema and whether a nextCursor follows
the listing is paginated; read the remaining page so no tool and no schema is missed
look up the quoted id T-103 exactly as the request gave it; the tool result will show whether it resolves
the tool result came back with isError true and no entry for T-103: a lookup miss, not a transport error; list the queue to find the CSV export ticket
the listing shows the CSV export ticket as T-104, not T-103; read that ticket to confirm its title and state
the ticket result confirms T-104 is the CSV export ticket and its state is open; report the id and state

recovery.intent: the error says the server restarted and the session was lost; initialize again before repeating the request
the new session is initialized; send notifications/initialized so the retried request is accepted
